desktop.prompt:
Generate ONE complete, long 1280px DESKTOP visual study of the current official Zapier homepage at https://zapier.com/ observed 2026-09-28. Render the full page and HTML. It is the 2026 "Welcome to automation in the agentic era" homepage, not the older generic automation builder. Reproduce the public page's actual structure, colors, typography, and mixed editorial/product imagery. Do not make a SaaS template.
FIRST 1280×720 VIEWPORT: #fffefb warm white page, sticky 56px white nav with fine bottom rule. At x40 black lower-case Zapier wordmark preceded by a short orange dash; links Products, Solutions, Resources, Enterprise, Pricing; far right GitHub glyph, explore-apps grid glyph, Contact sales, Log in, orange full-pill Sign up. Main hero leaves large whitespace to y150, centered small uppercase eyebrow "THE NEXT GENERATION OF ZAPIER". Large 56px regular Degular Display-like #201515 H1 in exactly TWO lines: "Welcome to automation / in the agentic era". Centered one-line supporting copy "Start building in your favorite AI tool, then run and govern trusted workflows on Zapier." Two horizontal buttons: orange square-cornered "Start free with email" and thin-black-outline white "Start free with Google" with Google mark. At y459 a wide 16:9 motion/product panel begins, edge-to-edge across viewport: blurred muted green/blue/beige background with a large white Zapier automation workflow app interface floating on it.
LONG-PAGE ORDER: Under hero/video a thin partner-logo strip labeled "TRUSTED BY THE WORLD’S BEST COMPANIES", with Nvidia, Meta, Lowe's, Cursor, Samsung, Okta, Mastercard, Dropbox, Shopify marks. Centered 48px H2 "Build anywhere. Run on Zapier. Govern in one place." two contrasting outlined/dark enterprise buttons. Three very different wide split editorial product rows on warm light background: left text and feature accordion, right large screenshot/video panel. Row 1 ZAPIER MCP / serif "Start building anywhere" / start workflow from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor; row 2 NEXT GEN ZAPS · EARLY ACCESS / serif "Run workflows reliably on Zapier" / trigger-flow canvas; row 3 after testimonial, AI AND AUTOMATION, GOVERNED / serif "Govern in one place" / governance dashboard. Between rows 2 and 3, FULL-WIDTH near-black #201515 customer quote band, huge white serif Kelly Scheib/Crunchbase quote on left and green photographic Crunchbase panel right. Then section "The Fluid Determinism difference" with 40px elegant serif heading, intro text and agency slider: Deterministic, Deterministic + AI, Deterministic + agent, Fully agentic; simple workflow illustration and cards. Next centered H2 "Built for everyone, from the Fortune 500 to first-time founders" and Mercari customer story carousel with large serif quote, orange metrics 47,000 tickets and 3,000+ agent hours. Then "Security built into every workflow" with spare horizontal security features: SOC 2 Type II & SOC 3, GDPR & CCPA, SSO + user provisioning, AI model opt-out, Observability; dark platform controls panel. Final orange-accented "Go from AI to ROI" CTA, then massive *dense* utility directory footer with Apps by title A-Z and columns of Top searches, Popular apps, Trending apps, Top apps by category, Our best content. Keep the uneven real page rhythms: big 16:9 media, quiet typographic editorial sections, one dark quote band, cardless text. The page is approximately 9,400 CSS pixels tall at 1280 wide.
Colors: body #fffefb, dark text #201515, vivid CTA #ff4f00, soft cream #f8f4f0. Degular Display-like regular sans major headings; Inter 14–18px nav/body; graceful Serrif-like serif subheadings and quotes. Buttons mostly square/low radius except orange signup pill. No purple gradients, uniform three-card layouts, pricing plans, fabricated logos or product claims. This gallery is free; original brand product pricing links may appear in the dated visual study. Generate actual screen and source HTML.
